class Game:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.puzzle = Puzzle(data)

    def show_board(self):
        p = self.puzzle
        print(f"\n--- {p.name}: {p.theme} ---")
        print(f"Merged {len(p.found)}/{len(p.answers)}: " + (", ".join(p.found) if p.found else "(none yet)"))
        print("Remaining strands:")
        for sid, text in p.strands:
            if sid in p.remaining:
                print(f"  [{sid}] {text}")

    def help(self):
        print("""Commands:
  status              Show remaining strands and progress
  merge <ids...>      Merge strands in the given order, e.g. merge 0 1 2
  build <word>        Try to form <word> from remaining strands
  hint                Reveal the segmentation of one unsolved word
  help                Show this help
  quit                Give up and quit this puzzle""")

    def hint(self):
        p = self.puzzle
        for ans, disp in p.answers:
            if disp not in p.found:
                print(f"Hint: '{disp}' = {' + '.join(ans)}")
                return
        print("No hints left - everything is solved!")

    def run(self):
        p = self.puzzle
        print(f"\nPuzzle: {p.name} | Theme: {p.theme}")
        self.help()
        self.show_board()
        while True:
            raw = input("\n> ").strip()
            if not raw: continue
            parts = raw.split()
            cmd, args = parts[0].lower(), parts[1:]
            if cmd in ("q", "quit"):
                print(f"Unsolved words: ..."); break
            elif cmd in ("h", "hint"): self.hint()
            elif cmd in ("s", "status"): self.show_board()
            elif cmd in ("?", "help", "commands"): self.help()
            elif cmd in ("m", "merge"):
                ids = [int(a) if a.lstrip('-').isdigit() else -1 for a in args]  # handle non-numeric

                else:
                    ok, msg = p.attempt_merge(ids)
                    print(msg)
                    if p.complete(): ... break
